title: Great app, but one small issue
body:
Overall, this is a great and user-friendly app.
However, there’s one inconvenience: when I select a past date, there’s no way to quickly return to today’s date with a single tap.
Instead, I have to keep tapping the “next day” button over and over, which becomes tedious.

It would be really helpful to have a “Today” button for quick navigation back to the current date.
author: Exz0
